تختلقوا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِقُوا (taḵtaliqū) /tax.ta.li.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
# تُخْتَلَقُوا (tuḵtalaqū) /tux.ta.la.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَقَ (iḵtalaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
